blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A full-duplex spoken dialogue model must yield when the user cuts in and hold when the user merely backchannels. Sequence-level RL with a timing reward (GRPO) is the usual recipe; we test its whole-rollout form on four open models and find two failures. A binary window reward gives zero advantage on exactly the windows that most need learning (a zero-gradient trap), and the one score per rollout is spread over listening-state decisions the reward is not written in terms of (credit leakage), so the model talks into silence or stops answering. Both come from sampling a reward that is a known function of a few binary control decisions. We propose \emph{window likelihood} (\WL): sample a continuation per window, but integrate in closed form over the stop decisions it visits and maximise the log-probability of acting correctly---a noisy-OR for yielding, a survival product for holding. On HumDial-FDBench, \WL\ gives the best yield/hold F1 on all six structurally different open models we post-train, exceeds Kyutai's released GRPO checkpoints (trained on different data), and adds no re-opening of the floor on any model.
blocks.zh: 当用户切入时,当用户仅仅是回声道时,一个全复式的口语对话模式必须产生效果。 附有计时奖励的序列级RL(GRPO)是常用的配方;我们用四个开放模型测试其整体推出形式并发现两个失败. 二进制窗口奖励在最需要学习的窗口上给予零优势(一个零分级的陷阱),每次推出的一分都分布在监听状态的决定上,奖励不写在(信用泄漏)上,所以模型谈话沉默或停止回答. 两者都来自对一些二进制控制决定中已知的奖励的抽样。 我们提议\emph{窗口概率}(\WL):每个窗口都抽取一个续作,但在它访问的停止决定中以闭合的形式整合,并最大限度地实现正确行事的对数概率 - - - - - - - ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 在HumDial-FDBench上,\WL\给我们所有6个结构上不同的开放模式上的最佳收益/持有F1,超过了Kyutai发布的GRPO检查站(根据不同数据训练),并且没有在任何模式上添加重新打开地板.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models ( Nguyen et al., 2023 ; Défossez et al., 2024 ; Veluri et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) emit speech and consume the user’s audio in the same stream, so the user can speak at any time. This makes one decision central: when the user starts talking while the model is talking, should the model yield or hold ? An interruption (“wait, what about the price?”) calls for an immediate stop; a backchannel (“uh-huh”, “right”) calls for continuing. Open models get this wrong in both directions. Moshi yields to only a minority of real interruptions ( Arora et al., 2025 ) , while the released Lychee-FD stops on half of the user’s backchannels ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . The two errors sit on a seesaw: post-training that makes a model stop more also makes it stop on backchannels, and vice versa.
blocks.zh: Full-duplex people speak-model (Nguyen等,2023; Défossez等,2024; Veluri等,2024; Wang等,2025;Liu等,2026) 发声并在同一流中消耗用户的音频,因此用户可以随时说话. 这让一个决定占据中心地位:当用户开始说话的时候,模型在说话的时候,该模型是产生还是持有呢? 中断(“等等,价格如何? ”) 要求立即停站;要求继续使用后道(“hh-huh”、“right”)。 开放型号在两个方向上都弄错了. Moshi的产量仅为少数实际中断(Arora等,2025年),而发布的Lychee-FD停在了用户的后道的一半上(Liu等,2026年). 两个错误坐落于锯道上:使模型停站更强的后期训练也使得它停在后道上,反之亦然.

blocks.en: The common remedy is reinforcement learning (RL) with a timing reward ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Ohashi et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Hsiao et al., 2026 ; Jung et al., 2026 ) : sample several continuations of a dialogue window, score each by whether the model stopped when it should, and update with a group-relative advantage (GRPO; Shao et al., 2024 ). We ran one deliberately whole-rollout GRPO configuration (§ 5.1 ) on four open models that expose an explicit stop decision, and found two failures:
blocks.zh: 常见的补救措施是加时分奖励的强化学习(RL)(Chen等,2025;Ohashi等,2026;Li等,2026;Hsiao等,2026;Jung等,2026;) :对对话窗口的几个续作样本,每分一次是否应该停止,并以群体相对优势进行更新(GROPO;Shao等,2024). 我们在四个公开模式上运行了一个故意完全推出的GPRO配置(§ 5.1),暴露了明确的停止决定,并发现两个失败:

blocks.en: • Zero-gradient trap. The window reward is binary. When all rollouts agree, the group-normalised advantage is zero: harmless on a window the policy already handles, a trap on the hard ones, where the base policy almost never stops (an interruption) or almost always stops (a backchannel). The windows on which all 16 rollouts fail are 23–34% of training windows on the three models we measured (§ 5.4 ). • Credit leakage. One score per rollout is spread over every decision in it, but only one or two in-window stop decisions determine the score. Most of the credited decisions are listening -state decisions (“when do I start talking?”), which the reward is not written in terms of, and the result is a side effect the reward never asked for: after GRPO, Lychee-FD re-opens the floor in every 100-s silence and Freeze-Omni stops answering the first question. Figure 4 (Appendix B ) shows both failures, and the intended behaviour, on one model. Both failures share a cause (Figure 1 ): GRPO treats the window reward as a black-box scalar on the whole rollout, when it is a known function of a handful of binary control decisions inside that window. Sampling a known function of a few Bernoulli variables is wasteful, because its expectation is available in closed form; spreading its score over every decision is misplaced, because the function names the decisions it depends on. We therefore marginalise the control decisions of the sampled continuation in closed form and maximise the resulting expected window reward as a log-likelihood, which we call window likelihood (WL). Two properties follow from the form of the objective (§ 4.2 ), one for each failure above.
blocks.zh: • 零升级陷阱。 窗口奖励为二进制. 当所有推出都同意时, 团体常态化的优势是0: 策略已经处理的窗口上无害, 所有16个推出失败的窗口是我们所测量的三种模式(第5.4节)的23-34%的培训窗口。 • 信用流失。 每次推出时都会有1分的分数分布在其中的每一个决定上,但只有一到两个窗口内停止决定决定分数. 大部分的信用决定都是听 - 状态决定("我何时开始说话?"),奖励不是用文字写的,结果是奖励从未要求过的副作用:在GRPO之后,Lychee-FD每100s的沉默中重新打开地板,而Freeze-Omni停止回答第一个问题. 图4(附录B)显示一种模式上的失败和预期行为。 两种失败都有一个原因(图1):GRPO将窗口奖励视为整个推出过程中的黑匣子活板,当它是该窗口内一小撮二进制控制决定的已知功能. 抽样一些伯努利变量的已知函数是浪费的,因为其期望是封闭的;将其分数分布在每个决定上是错的,因为函数命名了它所依赖的决定. 因此,我们以封闭的形式将所抽样的继续的控制决定边缘化,并将由此产生的预期窗口奖励最大化,作为类似日志的窗口,我们称之为窗口可能性(WL)。 目标形式(第4.2节)有两种属性,一种特性针对上面的失败。

blocks.en: We contribute (i) window likelihood, a closed-form replacement for sampled window rewards whose recipe applies whenever a verifiable reward is a known function of a few policy probabilities (§ 4 ); (ii) a measured account of two failures of whole-rollout GRPO on full-duplex models, with a causal ablation (§ 5.4 ); and (iii) a judge-free closed-loop protocol that also catches silence side effects, with results on six models (§ 5 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Open full-duplex models ( Nguyen et al., 2023 ; Défossez et al., 2024 ; Veluri et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025b ) differ in how, and whether, the stop decision is expressed (control branch, control tokens, VAD-gated state classifier, or none); we post-train one model of each kind (§ 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 开放的全复式模型(Nguyen等,2023;Défossez等,2024;Veluri等,2024;Zhang等,2024;Ma等,2025;Zhang等,2025;Yu等,2025b)在表达停止决定的方式和是否不同(控制分支,控制信号,VAD加分的状态分级器,或无);我们后训练出一种模型(§ 5.1).

blocks.en: Chen et al. (2025) apply online RL that balances barge-in against backchannel continuation on their own 1.1B model and synthetic tests. Ohashi et al. (2026) post-train Moshika and PersonaPlex with GRPO ( G = 16 G{=}16 rollouts per group) using rule-based rewards on four axes and an LLM content reward; we evaluate their released checkpoints. DuplexPO ( Li et al., 2026 ) applies GRPO only inside critical interaction windows with the history teacher-forced, which keeps the credit local but still samples the reward, and does not evaluate holding through a user backchannel. ASPIRin ( Hsiao et al., 2026 ) projects the action space onto speak/silent but still samples; HiPLEX ( Jung et al., 2026 ) routes sampled advantages to control decisions through event-causal masks, which is close to our speaking-only ablation. Preference-based variants build timing pairs offline ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025b ) ; all of these estimate the reward by sampling.

blocks.zh: 4.1 封闭式预期窗口奖励

(4) Here k k runs over the stop decisions visited inside the window (defined in the next paragraph). Equation ( 3 ) is a noisy-OR: the model stops at least once inside the window. Equation ( 4 ) is a survival likelihood: the model never stops inside the window. blocks.en: The p k p_{k} come from a teacher-forced pass over a continuation sampled from the current policy (the rollout; one or two per window, Appendix A ), at the speaking-state stop decisions visited inside the window, up to the continuation’s own stop if it has one. The visited decisions are marginalised in closed form; the content and any early stop are held fixed, and no gradient flows through the sampling. WL is therefore a teacher-forced likelihood on self-generated continuations—a surrogate rather than an unbiased estimator of the expected reward. There is no reward model, no group and no advantage.

blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We train the control head of Lychee-FD, an attention LoRA on MiniCPM-o and BayLing-Duplex, the state head of Freeze-Omni, and two text-projection rows on PersonaPlex and Moshika (Table 2 , Appendix A ). BayLing was never trained on backchannels; Freeze-Omni opens the floor only when its VAD fires, so its characteristic failure is not answering.
blocks.zh: 我们培训Lychee-FD的管制主管、MiniCPM-o和BayLing-Duplex的注意LORA、Stream-Omni的州主管以及PersonaPlex和Moshika的两行文字投影(附录A表2)。 BayLing从未在后道上被训练;Freezt-Omni只有在它的VAD起火时才打开地板,所以其特征故障就是没有回答.

blocks.en: All models are trained only on the interruption and backchannel clips of the HumDial Track-2 training set ( Wang et al., 2026 ) in the model’s test language (Chinese for Lychee-FD, MiniCPM-o and Freeze-Omni; English for the others). No silence, monologue or synthetic data is constructed; the only exception is the Moshi post-turn stage (§ 4.3 ), which uses the 16 s after the answer in the same backchannel dialogues. The training and test speakers and dialogues are disjoint.
blocks.zh: 所有型号都只接受该型号测试语言(中文指Lychee-FD,MiniCPM-o和Freezt-Omni;英文指其他型号)的HumDial Track-2训练集(Wang等,2026年)的中断和后道短片的培训. 没有构建出沉默,独白或合成数据;唯一的例外是莫希后转相(§ 4.3),它在同一回道对话框中使用答案后16 s. 培训和测试演讲者和对话是脱节的。

blocks.en: One deliberately standard configuration (“GRPO G16” in tables): one window and 16 rollouts per step, a ± 1 \pm 1 window reward, and a group-normalised advantage on every decision of the rollout, with the same KL weight, trained parameters and learning rate as WL (mechanics in Appendix A ). Rollouts begin before the model’s first answer by our choice, so the policy also makes the listening-state decisions; windowed variants such as DuplexPO start inside the window, and the speaking-only ablation below is our nearest analogue. The two are matched on event-window rollouts and trained parameters; the remaining confounds (auxiliary terms, windows per step) are stated in § 5.4 .
blocks.zh: 一个故意标准配置(“GPRO G16”):每步一个窗口和16个推出,一个±1\pm 1窗口奖励,以及一个团体对推出的每一决定的常态化优势,其KL重量,训练参数和学习率与WL(附录A中的机械)相同. 在模型的首个答案由我们选择之前就开始推出,因此政策也做出监听状态的决定;有窗口的变体,如"双相"(DuplexPO),从窗口内开始,下面只有说话的减速就是我们最近的模拟. 两者在事件窗口的推出和训练有素的参数上相匹配;其余的混乱(辅助术语,每步窗口)则在第5.4节中表述.

blocks.en: Identical, but the advantage is applied only to decisions made while the model is speaking; this is the causal ablation of § 5.4 .
blocks.zh: 同样,但这一优势只适用于在模型发言时作出的决定;这是第5.4节的因果关系。

blocks.en: The authors’ released checkpoints of Ohashi et al. (2026) for PersonaPlex and Moshika, trained with G = 16 G{=}16 on 4,000 h of dialogue with multi-axis LLM-judged rewards. We build no GRPO baseline of our own for these two models: without a control channel, both the action projection and the speaking-state definition would be ours to invent.
blocks.zh: 提交人为PersonaPlex和Moshika释放了Ohashi等人(2026年)的检查站,他们用G=16 GQQ 16进行了与LLM评分的多轴对话4 000 h的训练。 我们没有为这两个模型建立我们自己的GRPO基线:没有控制通道,动作投影和说话状态定义都将是我们发明的.

blocks.en: Turn-taking benchmarks include Full-Duplex-Bench ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , Talking Turns ( Arora et al., 2025 ) , SID-Bench ( Xia et al., 2026 ) and HumDial ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) ; we use HumDial-FDBench ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) because it contains real-recorded interruptions and user backchannels in two languages. It provides, per language, 1,500 real-recorded interruptions in five categories (ask a follow-up, deny, ask to repeat, shift topic, ask to wait; 300 each) and 300 user backchannels (examples in Table 3 , Appendix B ). Chinese is used for Lychee-FD, MiniCPM-o and Freeze-Omni, English for the others; third-party-speech categories are out of scope. Every configuration is a single training run; we report 95% bootstrap confidence intervals over test items (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 转会基准包括Full-Duplex-Bench(Lin等,2025年),Talking Turns(Arora等,2025年),SID-Bench(Xia等,2026年)和HumDial(赵等,2026年)等;我们使用HumDial-FDBench(赵等,2026年),因为它包含真实记录的中断和用户回声道两种语言. 它按语言提供1500个真实记录的中断,分为5个类别(任务后续,否认,要求重复,转移话题,要求等待;每个300个)和300个用户后通道(附录B表3中的例子). 中国语用于Lychee-FD,MiniCPM-o和Freezt-Omni等,英语用于其他;第三方-口语类已超出范围. 每个配置都是单一的训练运行;我们报告95%的靴子置信间隔在测试项目上(附录B).

blocks.en: 5.2 Closed-Loop Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 5.2 闭环评价协议

blocks.en: Timing behaviour can only be measured when the event actually happens: an interruption that arrives while the model is silent tests nothing. Benchmarks that replay a fixed user track, such as Full-Duplex-Bench and the official HumDial scoring, cannot guarantee this, because when a model starts and stops talking differs from model to model. We therefore evaluate all six models with one closed-loop protocol.
blocks.zh: 计时行为只有在事件实际发生时才能被测量:在模型是无声测试时到达的中断. 重放固定用户音轨的基准,如"Full-Duplex-Bench"和"HumDial"的官方评分,不能保证这一点,因为当一个模型开始和停止说话时,模型之间会有所不同. 因此,我们用一个闭路协议评估所有六个模式。

blocks.en: The simulator plays the user’s question, waits for the model to start answering, and injects the real interjection recording 0.8, 1.6 or 2.4 s after the model’s onset (rotated across items). An item is valid only if the model is still speaking at injection time; invalid items are dropped and the valid count n n is reported, so a model cannot score by staying silent. The same clips, delays and seeds are used for every model and configuration.
blocks.zh: 模拟器播放用户的问题,等待模型开始回答,并在模型发作后(跨项旋转)注入真实的插出,记录了0.8,1.6或2.4 s. 只有当模型在注入时仍在说话时,一个项目才有效;无效的项目被丢弃并报告有效的计分nn,所以一个模型不能通过保持沉默来得分. 每个模型和配置都使用同样的剪辑,延迟和种子.

blocks.en: An interruption counts as a yield, and a backchannel as a false stop, if the model’s own stop decision fires within 2 s of the interjection onset—the same window for every model, Freeze-Omni included. The decision is read from the channel of Table 2 ; for the Moshi family it is a gap of ≥ \geq 0.8 s in output energy (within-answer pauses exceed 0.8 s in only 1–2.5% of cases, and a 1.2-s criterion preserves every ordering in Table 1 ). Reading the decision instead of transcribing the audio makes the metric deterministic and reproducible, and keeps it independent of each model’s speech quality.
blocks.zh: 如果该模型本身的停止决定点火发生在插出点的2秒内——每个模型的同一窗口,包括冻结-Omni,则中断算作产量,反通道算作假站。 从表2的频道读取决定;对于Moshi家族来说,是输出能量相差0.8秒(在只有1-2.5%的案例中,回答内暂停超过0.8秒,1.2分标准保留了表1中的每个顺序)。 阅读决定,而不是转录音频,使衡量标准具有确定性和可复制性,并独立于每个模型的语音质量。

blocks.en: The official HumDial scoring labels ASR transcripts with DeepSeek-V3 without human validation ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and transcript judges agree with humans only moderately on turn-taking (Krippendorff’s α = 0.61 \alpha=0.61 in Full-Duplex-Bench v2, Lin et al., 2026 ; below 80% agreement in Talking Turns, Arora et al., 2025 ; scores that have not reproduced across papers, Ohashi et al., 2026 ; Jung et al., 2026 ). More fundamentally, a transcript records what was said, not when the model decided to stop; we therefore use no judge, and I I , B B and F1 follow from binary events on the model’s own timeline.
blocks.zh: 官方的HumDial评分标签为ASR记录片与DeepSeek-V3,未经人类验证(Wang等,2026年),记录片法官只与人类中度同意转会(Krippendorff的α=0.61\alpha=0.61,Full-Duplex-Bench v2,Lin等,2026年;Talking Turns中低于80%的协议, Arora等,2025;没有跨论文转载的分数,Ohashi等,2026;Jung等,2026. 更根本地说,记录一下所说的话,而不是当模型决定停止的时候;因此,我们没有使用任何法官,我、B和F1从模型自己的时间线上的二进制事件中走出来。

blocks.en: A timing reward can also be satisfied by talking more. To catch this we add a test that event-window training never touches: the user asks one question, the model answers, and the user then stays silent for 100 s. We report how often the model re-opens the floor, i.e. talks into silence, and how many seconds it speaks in the window (40 English questions shared by all six models; Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 时间奖励也可以通过多说来满足. 为了抓住这一点,我们增加了一个测试,即事件窗口训练从不触及:用户问一个问题,模型答案,然后用户保持沉默100 s. 我们报告该模型如何频繁地重新打开地上,即进行静默的交谈,以及它在窗口中发言的几秒钟(所有六个模型共用40个英文问题;附录B)。

blocks.en: 5.4 Two GRPO Failures, Measured
blocks.zh: 5.4 两个GRPO故障,计量

blocks.en: In our GRPO runs, the share of training windows on which all 16 rollouts agree is 72% for Lychee-FD, 19% for MiniCPM-o, 36% for BayLing and 91% for Freeze-Omni (Figure 3 a). The trap is driven by individual windows, not by the average stop rate: on 64 Lychee-FD training windows the mean stop probability is 0.885, yet 61% of the windows sit at S ≤ 0.05 S\leq 0.05 or S ≥ 0.95 S\geq 0.95 (Figure 2 , bottom). The windows on the wrong side of the extreme, where all 16 rollouts fail, are 23% of Lychee-FD’s, 33% of BayLing’s and 34% of Freeze-Omni’s training windows (64, 30 and 41 windows logged). A sampled group yields nothing on them, and they are where the WL gradient is largest (§ 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在我们的GRPO运行中,所有16个推出商都同意的培训窗口份额为:Lychee-FD72%,MiniCPM-o19%,BayLing36%,Street-Omni91%(图3a)。 陷阱由单个窗口所驱动,而不是由平均停站率所驱动:在64个Lychee-FD训练窗口上,平均停站概率为0.885,然而61%的窗口坐落于S 0.05 S\leq 0.05或S 0.95 S\geq 0.95 (图2,下方). 极端的倒数倒数倒数的窗口是Lychee-FD的23%、BayLing的33%和Stream-Omni的34%的训练窗口(记录了64个、30个和41个窗口 ) 。 抽样调查的一组人对其不产生任何结果,而它们正是WL梯度最大的地方(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3 b measures how much of GRPO’s advantage lands on decisions the reward does not depend on. The event window holds 47% of the credited decisions for Lychee-FD, 25% for MiniCPM-o and Freeze-Omni, and 15% for BayLing. For Freeze-Omni, 69% of credited decisions are listening decisions made while the user is still asking the first question—the direct source of its no-answer failure; for BayLing, 50% fall in the question and 24% in the answer before the event. The speaking-only ablation (Table 1 ) is the causal test: removing the gradient from listening decisions removes Lychee-FD’s talking into silence (100% → \to 0%), cuts MiniCPM-o’s false stops (34.7% → \to 11.9%), removes BayLing’s collapse without improving on the base ( I I 4.9% → \to 77.7%, F1 32.7 vs 32.3) and halves Freeze-Omni’s no-answer rate on development-subset interruptions (72% → \to 50%) while still collapsing. The ablation thus localises the collapses to listening-state credit but does not recover a working GRPO, and it stays below WL on all four models (84.2 / 83.9 / 32.7 / 0.8). We cannot attribute the remaining gap to the zero-gradient trap alone: WL also receives the auxiliary terms and sees more distinct windows per step, neither of which the GRPO baseline has, and on MiniCPM-o, where only 19% of groups are uniform, the gap is still 5.7 F1. WL’s own freedom from leakage is measured for the full loss of ( 5 ); the event term alone is not isolated.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Window likelihood replaces a sampled window reward by its closed-form expectation over the few control decisions the reward depends on. On six open full-duplex models with four control interfaces it gives the best yield/hold F1 and shows neither of the two GRPO failures we measured, while training only a stop-decision head where one exists and an attention LoRA otherwise. We argue the same move applies whenever a verifiable reward is a known function of a few policy probabilities, and WL could serve as the timing term inside windowed RL.
blocks.zh: 窗口可能性用其封闭形式对奖励所依赖的少数控制决定的期望来取代被抽样的窗口奖励. 在有四个控制界面的六个开放的全复式模型上,它给出了最佳的产量/持有量F1,并显示我们测得的两个GRPO故障都没有,而训练的只有存在一个断层决定头,而LORA另加注意. 我们主张,当可核查的奖励是少数政策概率的已知函数时,同样的做法也适用,而WL可以作为窗口的RL内部的时间期限.

blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: WL improves Freeze-Omni from F1 19.7 to 40.5, still low: its VAD-gated linear state head cannot separate “the user is still asking” from “the user has just asked”, and the window data carry no information about that distinction.

blocks.en: In BayLing-Duplex, [EPAD] means both “yield” and “end of answer”, so suppressing it on backchannels leaks into answer endings: 30% of WL’s first answers do not end within 120 s in the silence test (Appendix B ).

blocks.en: Event rows: active when output energy exceeded the speech threshold within the last 0.64 s and the user channel became active while the model was speaking, until 2 s after the user’s energy drops. Post-turn rows: active once the model has answered and both channels have been silent for 0.8 s, until the user speaks. A LoRA on the whole text head trained with the same objective collapses into non-stop babbling within ten steps, because “keep talking” is trivially satisfied by emitting words.
blocks.zh: 事件行:当输出能量在后0.64 s 内超过语音阈值时活动,在模型发声时用户通道开始活动,直到用户能量下降后2 s. 后回转行:一旦模型解答完毕,两个频道都沉默了0.8 s,直到用户说话. 整个文字头部的LORA训练有素,目标相同,在十步内倒塌成不停地说出话来,因为“继续说话”对发泄的言词稍有满意。

blocks.zh: 表5:PersonaPlex上的Gating ablusing(开发子集:问 + 拒绝中断和所有后道;整集的订单相同,上行得分77.2). 副作用沿着大门,而不是目标.

blocks.en: Table 5 varies only where the two learned rows are active (variant chosen on this development subset). Ungated, the readout leaks into listening like GRPO (97% re-opening); an energy gate drifts toward “keep talking” (7.5% of first answers never end); the event gate matches the base outside events, and the post-turn rows remove the base’s own re-opening without touching I I or B B .
blocks.zh: 表5仅在两个学习行活动时(在这一发展子集上选择的变量)才有所不同. 未经证实,读出会像GRPO(97%重新打开);能量门向“保持对话”飘去(7.5%的首个回答从未结束);事件门与外部事件的基座相匹配,而后转行取消了基座自己的重开而未触及I或B.
